items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: See, we made up that band and started playing among ourselves. And then when we got where we could play enough to go out and play, we named it the Peerless Band.

ctx.x: Wait a minute. I didn't get that straight. Who was on drums?
Ernest Gardette Jr., I see. Mm-hmm. Well, I got it straight now. Which was the Peerless band?
